scope: Eight new exact-article/indication records across six mechanism families and two existing-lead updates. Public-evidence desk research; no outreach, material procurement or experiments.
counting_rule: Eight exact-article/use records across six mechanism families. RGN-259 and lufepirsen are clinical-program/comparator screens, not independently available assets. Two AEC and two BEST1 articles remain separate to prevent claim transfer. Related anthracycline cardioprotection hits are not diMe-Doxo AEC.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: RM4404/WAY-262611 for delayed corneal sensory repair
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: WAY-262611 (CAS 1123231-07-1) in the disclosed Kolliphor HS-15 micellar preparation RM4404; not a new chemical entity.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: Persistent corneal hypoesthesia after stromal nerve injury.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: The mouse mechanical-injury study dosed on days 7–14 and observed sensation to day 30, 16 days after dosing ended. A separate days 5–10 protocol measured day-14 function in mechanical and chemical models; this is four days off treatment, not verified pharmacokinetic washout.
Supplemental S2: day-14 surgical-model medians 4.5 at either dose versus 2.79 vehicle, total N=22 across three arms; chemical-model medians 4.585/4.625 versus 2.040 vehicle, total N=12.

Randomization and blinded secondary imaging review were reported. Primary quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved. Both surgical-model eyes were analyzed as independent; chemical-model injury involved one eye per mouse. Main day-30 tests against healthy controls establish neither equivalence nor a reported direct drug–vehicle contrast.

At day 30, axonal-network medians were 357.7 with vehicle and 362.1 with RM4404 (healthy 394.6). Different significance results against healthy controls do not establish a drug–vehicle structural advantage.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Animal is the biological block. Surgical-model eyes and repeat thresholds are nested; N=22 must not be described as 22 independent mice. Chemical-model N=12 is total across three arms, not 12 treated animals.
limitations: No retrieved independent-laboratory replication, active repair comparator, human tissue efficacy or unbound corneal exposure.
Primary-quantifier and sensory-assessor blinding remain unresolved; section 2.9 does describe blinded secondary reexamination of imaging. The supplemental questionnaire was not recovered.
Stock arithmetic implies 0.2% versus 2% DMSO. The vehicle is called similarly prepared without explicit accounting: qualification ambiguity, not proven confounding.
Stored-particle TEM does not establish chemical potency, release, sterility or shelf life.

readiness.identity: Parent compound and formulation publicly specified.
readiness.material_route: Original Sigma317700 and independent Cayman17704 listing. No qualified lot received or physical stock confirmed.
readiness.model: Public mouse strains and injury model; an independent team must qualify the disease deficit and analysis unit.
readiness.exposure: Nominal topical 20/200 µM; relevant tissue/free exposure unknown.
readiness.rights: UConn intellectual-property disclosure and US provisional application acknowledged; exact status/claim scope not mapped.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: New high-priority reserve for independent functional replication; no S-tier promotion.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: Animal-level randomized, masked delayed functional rescue beats an active comparator at measured corneal exposure, persists after washout, and preserves clarity, barrier and healthy protective sensation.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Effect disappears under animal-level analysis or solvent matching, reflects only reflex excitability, has no comparative value, or harms normal tissue.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: Topical APR-246/PRIMA-1MET for chronic TP63-AEC erosions
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Eprenetapopt/PRIMA-1MET/APR-246 in the published 0.6 mg/g Seraqua cream.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: Established chronic AEC skin erosions; initial human variants I576T and I537T.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: Two children received compassionate treatment; one had an opposite-palm vehicle comparison. Re-epithelialization and pain improvement were reported, but the treated palm remained incompletely cornified at week 33.
Patient keratinocyte differentiation improved without reducing p63 aggregates.
Published chemical quality controls and three-week refrigerated formulation stability provide a material starting point.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Two independent patients. Two palms in one patient and in-vitro repeats do not add patients.
limitations: No randomized efficacy estimate, long-term withdrawal result, skin exposure-response or quantitative normal-skin/DNA-damage margin recovered.
Time and wound-care effects remain possible; a contralateral control helps one case but does not establish generalizability.
Systemic oncology tolerability cannot qualify chronic exposure of damaged pediatric skin.

readiness.material_route: Original study used Bio-Techne/R&D Systems powder with quality controls; independent lot still needs authentication.
readiness.model: Published patient keratinocyte/iPSC routes; exact line stock not verified. Engineered TP63 tissue would require separate qualification.
readiness.exposure: Nominal 30 µM differentiation assay used pretreatment; cream concentration is not measured viable-skin exposure.
readiness.rights: US12521392B2 granted in January 2026. Claim 1 includes AEC affecting at least one cornea; dependent claims include cream/skin erosions. Neither blanket exclusion nor FTO follows.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: New translational reserve; prioritize durable barrier/cornification and exposure proof.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: Independent established-defect human epidermis shows durable mechanical/barrier recovery and cornification at measured exposure, with a normal-tissue and DNA-damage margin and an appropriate wound-care comparator.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Coverage lacks functional barrier, benefit depends on toxic cell selection, chronic exposure is implausible, or comparator/withdrawal removes the advantage.

new_candidate_screens.exact_article: 2-naphthoxyacetic acid; sodium 4-phenylbutyrate is a separate active reference.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: BEST1 R255Q recessive and K30R dominant patient-derived RPE models.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: The 2020 study reports chloride-current rescue in patient RPE. The K30R increase was significant for 4PBA, not 2-NOAA.
Key rescue assays used nominal 2.5 mM. Channel current is physiological function, but does not establish restored RPE transport, photoreceptor support or vision.
2-NOAA increases BEST1 transcription, while 4PBA has a different mode of action.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Two disease donor backgrounds and an unrelated normal control are described. Patched-cell n is not patient n; independent donor-stratified replication is not established.
limitations: High nominal exposure lacks a verified unbound human RPE bridge.
No positive clinical trial or independent exact-compound tissue-function replication was established.
Normal cargo handling and effects of increased mutant expression need qualification.

readiness.identity: Chemical structure and synthesis literature public.
readiness.material_route: Public chemistry route; no qualified lot received.
readiness.model: Published patient iPSC-RPE; exact line stock unverified.
readiness.exposure: Nominal 2.5 mM rescue without a clinical retinal exposure bridge.
readiness.rights: No complete commercial/patent review; no availability or FTO conclusion.

new_candidate_screens.advance_if: A lower-exposure exact article restores polarized RPE function and photoreceptor support in mutant/corrected models while preserving normal cargo handling.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Rescue remains confined to high nominal exposure, fails at tissue function, or has no practical exposure route.

new_candidate_screens.exact_article: 0.1% sterile preservative-free RGN-259 thymosin beta-4 ophthalmic solution.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: Stage 2/3 neurotrophic keratopathy with persistent epithelial defects.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: SEER-1 randomized 18 participants: 6/10 active versus 1/8 placebo healed after four weeks; primary Fisher P=0.0656. A significant later day-43 secondary endpoint does not reverse the primary result.
The official HLB August 26, 2026 notice says SEER-2 procedures finished and analysis was underway, with anticipated mid-November topline. This is not an observed efficacy outcome.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: 18 actual SEER-1 participants. Planned later enrollment or site counts are not observed efficacy subjects.
limitations: Small initial trial, imprecise effect size, and multiple secondary outcomes.
Research thymosin beta-4 is not automatically equivalent to the clinical formulation.

readiness.material_route: Established sponsor program; independently synthesized peptide requires comparability.
readiness.exposure: Clinical topical precedent, without rights or comparability for an independent copy.
readiness.rights: Active HLB/ReGenTree/RegeneRx program; not an abandoned-asset conclusion.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: Clinical benchmark and public-results watch; not a new independent venture shortlist asset.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: A differentiated product demonstrates an endpoint or administration advantage; incorporate actual SEER-2 results when published.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: The proposal duplicates the sponsored program or treats secondary or predicted future outcomes as confirmatory efficacy.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: Lufepirsen/NEXAGON for persistent corneal epithelial defects
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Connexin43 antisense oligonucleotide in NEXAGON ophthalmic gel; distinct from alphaCT1 and tonabersat.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: Persistent corneal epithelial defects refractory to conventional care.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: A primary Glaukos filing and IRB-approved investigator-hosted brochure establish a clinical program; the brochure specifies NEXAGON 0.06% versus vehicle.
A current registry mirror reports an ongoing trial. Primary registry dynamic content and numerical randomized outcomes were not recovered.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: No observed outcome denominator verified. Planned 84/144 figures across mirrors must not be counted as actual participants.
limitations: Complete clinical oligonucleotide/gel manufacturing comparability was not mapped.
Same-target peptide or channel-blocker data cannot be transferred to an antisense article.
The 2026 brochure upload path contains a page marked July 2024; it alone cannot prove current recruitment.

readiness.identity: Clinical article identified; independent full specification not verified.
readiness.material_route: Sponsor-controlled clinical product; a molecular name is not qualified material.
readiness.exposure: Clinical gel concentration described, without an independent exposure bridge.
readiness.rights: Known Glaukos program. Current mirror status retains a primary-verification gap.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: Comparator/program screen without efficacy or independent-development promotion.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: Public results or independent exact-article evidence establish a distinct development contribution.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: The case depends on another same-target article, unread results or assumed program neglect.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: Phosphosulindac/OXT-328 for aqueous-deficient dry-eye sensory dysfunction
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Phosphosulindac in published Carbopol hydrogel F8; not unmodified sulindac.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: The 2026 rabbit study reports rapid reversible corneal-sensitivity improvement; 0.2% hydrogel maintained normalization roughly 26–27 h.
Normal-eye sensitivity was suppressed. Assays report four eyes per time point. Acute comparison with cyclosporine/lifitegrast does not establish superiority to chronic clinical therapy.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Eyes are observational units; independent animal counts for each formulation comparison were not fully resolved.
limitations: Immediate reversible response supports sensory modulation, not established axonal regeneration.
Blink responsiveness does not establish pain relief or useful protective function.
Healthy-eye sensory suppression needs an exposure window.
Medicon/Apis interests are disclosed; no program abandonment inferred.

readiness.material_route: Original material was a Medicon gift; no independently authenticated lot.
readiness.model: Public rabbit model; anatomy/function and animal clustering need qualification.
readiness.exposure: Formulation strength is not free corneal exposure.
readiness.rights: Commercial development interests disclosed; claim scope unmapped.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: Sensory-pharmacology comparator; not a regenerative-lead promotion.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: Repeated dosing improves disease function beyond acute excitability while preserving healthy protective sensation, with clinically appropriate comparators.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Only transient reflex modulation remains, no quality-of-function advantage appears, or normal sensation is impaired at effective exposure.

new_candidate_screens.exact_article: diMe-Doxo, separated from doxorubicin and epirubicin.
new_candidate_screens.disease_or_use: AEC-associated p63 aggregation, initially the L514F model.

coverage_record_matches.label: Biased neuregulin receptor geometry for cardiac repair
Covalent bivalent neuregulin-1β (NN) for anthracycline cardioprotection · [Study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3753575/)

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: The 2025 study reports p63 disaggregation and target-gene rescue in engineered cells and mouse primary keratinocytes.
Prior reduced cardiotoxicity does not mean no toxicity: cell-viability effects in the AEC study were comparable with other anthracyclines.
No established human barrier/wound repair or AEC patient treatment efficacy was recovered.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Cell/keratinocyte replicates are not patients. Independent mouse/litter denominator was not extracted for this bounded screen.
limitations: Transcriptional rescue can coexist with cytotoxicity.
Reduced cardiotoxicity does not qualify chronic skin DNA/chromatin effects.
Exact-analog physical availability was not verified.

readiness.material_route: Research synthesis route, without a qualified lot.
readiness.model: Published Tp63 L514F mouse keratinocytes; human functional model needed.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: Mechanistic reserve below APR-246 for translational proof.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: Functional barrier/cornification benefit exceeds APR-246 at noncytotoxic measured exposure.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Reporter rescue tracks cell loss/DNA damage or fails to produce tissue repair.

new_candidate_screens.candidate: Tadalafil for selected BEST1 M325T dysfunction
new_candidate_screens.exact_article: Tadalafil; an exact repurposed molecule distinct from 2-NOAA and 4PBA.

novelty_basis.note: New to this portfolio is not patent novelty or absence of an existing commercial program.

evidence: 25 µM tadalafil restored M325T chloride current in transfected HEK293T cells, but not R141H or L234V.
Sec24a binding is a docking hypothesis; direct engagement and patient-RPE benefit were not established.
The 100-fold difference from 2.5 mM 4PBA is a nominal assay-concentration comparison, not demonstrated clinical potency.
new_candidate_screens.independent_biological_unit: Engineered cells; no independent patient-donor efficacy cohort.
limitations: No verified unbound human retinal-exposure bridge for 25 µM cell treatment.
Cannot inherit 2-NOAA/4PBA patient-RPE results.
Variant restriction rules out generic all-BEST1 positioning.

readiness.material_route: Research/manufacturing routes exist; study-lot comparability not verified.
readiness.model: Public engineered-channel assay; disease-RPE function needs qualification.
readiness.exposure: Nominal 25 µM, without free ocular PK bridge.
readiness.rights: No all-indication FTO or regulatory repurposing assurance.

new_candidate_screens.verdict: Variant-specific exposure-gated reserve below the priority shortlist.
new_candidate_screens.advance_if: M325T patient or corrected-isogenic RPE recovers polarized function at justified exposure while retaining normal cargo handling.
new_candidate_screens.stop_or_deprioritize_if: Only overexpression responds, exposure is implausible, or normal RPE function is compromised.

existing_candidate_updates.verdict: Retain conditional proof priority; no promotion
evidence_deltas: Both culture variants lie in the SERCA2 actuator domain. Mean protein abundance is about 70% of control; it is not a measured 50%-protein-null model. Calcium imaging in the retrieved section used DD2.
DD5–7 were biopsy immunohistochemistry samples, not additional NDC-treated culture donors.
DD3–4 required Y27632 during maintenance; all DD cultures and CTL1–2 received it for consistency. It was removed 24–36 h before assays, so there is no demonstrated concurrent ROCK-inhibitor confound.

The 2023 healthy-neuron result involved spine-neck morphology at 0.1 µM, with at least 10 neurons / 70 spines from one culture batch. It is not observed skin toxicity; the 2025 intraperitoneal CNS study does not qualify topical exposure.
The Darier paper section titled Solubility assay measures protein detergent solubility, not dissolved NDC-9009.
existing_candidate_updates.decision_implication: Qualify models by measured residual SERCA function and an established, rescuable adhesion/barrier deficit. Total protein and ATP2A2 diagnosis alone do not establish suitability. Link drug exposure to ER refilling and tissue function; keep genotype and donor strata separate.
existing_candidate_updates.advance_if: Delayed mature-epidermis cohesion/barrier benefit exceeds appropriate NAC, CDN1163 and clinical-route comparators at measured exposure while preserving healthy epidermis.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_or_narrow_if: Only junction assembly improves, benefit depends on a stressor/vehicle, no useful comparator margin exists, or the disease state lacks activatable residual protein.

existing_candidate_updates.verdict: Strengthen comparator rationale; actual trial outcomes remain unknown
evidence_deltas: The October 8, 2026 primary abstract reports mitochondrial calcium/respiration and adhesion improvement partly via MCU; full dose and donor denominators were not recovered.
Listing ATP2A2-knockout models does not establish which model showed the adhesion result; no knockout-specific rescue is inferred.

Official registry confirms trial completion in September 2025. A mirror lists SUM-151495 version 2, dated September 8 and submitted September 10, 2026. Actual efficacy, adverse events and actual enrollment remain unread; planned 20 is not actual N.
existing_candidate_updates.decision_implication: Dantrolene provides an alternative calcium/mitochondrial comparator. Oral trial completion establishes neither topical efficacy nor failure. Investigator outreach is not a scientific-selection gate.
existing_candidate_updates.advance_if: Retrieved primary trial results or independent delayed epidermal repair establishes a route-specific advantage at feasible exposure.
existing_candidate_updates.stop_or_narrow_if: No mature functional benefit at a tolerable local exposure or worse healthy-tissue function than simpler comparators.

priority_changes: Add RM4404 as a high-priority independent-validation reserve; address paired-eye analysis and formulation controls.
Add topical APR-246 as a translational reserve with human chronic-lesion precedent.
Keep NDC-9009 conditional on mature epidermal function and exposure; no promotion.
Keep RGN-259 and lufepirsen as competitive benchmarks, with public-result gaps explicit.
unresolved_retrievals: Dantrolene CTIS actual results document SUM-151495.
RM4404 supplemental documents and primary-quantifier/sensory-assessor blinding details; secondary imaging review is described in the main text.
Primary current dynamic NEXPEDE-1 registry payload.
Independent replication and free-exposure bridges for new early leads.
s_tier_assessment: No candidate establishes an independently replicated, exposure-qualified, differentiated and transferable development case. RM4404 and APR-246 provide concrete new proof opportunities, not funding guarantees.

comparative_priority_note.APR246_vs_NDC9009: APR-246 has stronger human species/timing evidence and a more concrete published formulation. Reserve status reflects unresolved durable functional barrier/cornification, withdrawal and chronic local exposure-to-harm window, not lack of an owner response or inherently weaker efficacy. NDC also lacks mature-lesion rescue and a topical margin; the public record does not establish overall superiority. Small independent qualification of both is justified. Promote APR-246 ahead if durable barrier and a useful margin are established or NDC remains prevention-only.
comparative_priority_note.rights: Map actual claims in parallel; neither patent titles nor unanswered commercial questions decide the biology.
